answer: A live-proctored exam makes each extra identity pay $150 for one seat and one live body before a webcam; a farm running N fakes pays N×$150 and N sitters and cannot share it because one certificate names one candidate. Pearson VUE checks the ID, scans the room and records 130 minutes, filing each sitting on a vine of past attempts beside a meadow of scored sessions. A farm sending one sitter to two seats dies by proctor photo check at 2: the second seat flags both, both certificates void, the $300 sunk in a lagoon of forfeited fees.
